items.title: What's going on with the state of consumer prices?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley and Tech Editor Dan Howley join Julie Hyman on Morning Brief to discuss the state of consumer prices on the heels of the Consumer Price Index print released today. Prices rose 0.1% month over month and 3.4% year over year in July, and Core CPI — which excludes food and energy costs — rose 0.2% monthly and 2.5% yearly. All numbers matched economists' estimates.

items.title: Goldman Sachs to Acquire NEOS Investments in Deal Worth Up to $2.25B, Expanding Options-Based ETF Lineup
items.summary: Goldman Sachs will acquire NEOS Investments in a deal worth up to $2.25 billion, adding $30 billion in options-based income ETFs and vaulting Goldman Sachs Asset Management into the ranks of top-eight active ETF issuers.
